page: Microsoft Azure DC16ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine designed around confidential computing and balanced enterprise workloads. It operates on the x86_64 architecture powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor. The configuration allocates 16 virtual CPUs derived from 8 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU cache layout includes 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 32 MB of shared L3 cache, backed by instruction extensions including AVX-512 (with VNNI and BF16 extensions), VAES, and SHA-NI for cryptographic efficiency.

Memory capacity is configured at 64 GB of RAM, sustaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4 GB per virtual core. Unlike diskless general-purpose tiers, the DC16ads_v6 includes 644 GB of direct-attached local SSD storage alongside support for Azure Premium Storage. The instance does not feature graphics processing hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses, keeping infrastructure resources focused on compute, local caching, and encrypted virtualization.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong single-core compute performance, with stress-ng recording 3025.68 points, placing it in the top quartile of evaluated instances. Multi-core compute yields steady midrange performance, reflected by a stress-ng multi-core score of 24139.52 and a PassMark CPU score of 25617.93. Geekbench scores follow a similar pattern, registering 1845.0 in single-core and 11173.0 in multi-core metrics, with text processing standing out in the upper tier at 2510.0. In memory and caching throughput tests, the instance executed 20.29 million Redis SET operations per second alongside 7366.97 PassMark database operations.

With its integrated 644 GB local SSD and balanced compute density, the DC16ads_v6 offers solid qualitative cost efficiency for systems requiring temporary local scratch space without consuming external block storage fees. The combination of hardware-level cryptographic instructions, strong single-threaded throughput, and symmetric memory ratios makes this instance suitable for secure web serving, relational databases, CI/CD compilation, and enterprise business applications.
description: Microsoft Azure DC16ads_v6 is a general-purpose virtual machine featuring an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor running on Microsoft Hyper-V. The system is provisioned with 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores, 64 GB of system memory, and 644 GB of direct-attached local SSD storage. Designed with an x86_64 architecture supporting AVX-512 and hardware cryptographic instructions, the instance exhibits top-quartile single-core performance in stress-ng benchmarks and steady mid-tier multi-core execution. Synthetic database operations and Redis SET benchmarks show balanced throughput, capable of processing over 20 million operations per second. With a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and bundled fast local storage, the instance delivers a reliable baseline for applications needing scratch disk capacity and confidential computing capabilities. The DC16ads_v6 is suited for enterprise relational databases, web application servers, CI/CD build environments, and containerized microservices.
